Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 31 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market. Chandra Asri is currently expanding its portfolio in the energy sector and incorporating its asset as well as operational infrastructure to supports the expansion plan of the second world-scale integrated petrochemical complex in Indonesia, CAP2.
Responsibilities :

• Shall act as the Company's focal point for the development and implementation of the Port Facility Security Management System in coordination with the appointed Recognized Security Organization (RSO).
• Lead and coordinate the preparation of the Port Facility Security Assessment (PFSA).
• Review and validate PFSA findings, security risks, and recommended mitigation measures proposed by the RSO.
• Coordinate the development, review, and finalization of the Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP).
• Ensure PFSP is practical, operationally effective, and aligned with terminal operations.
• Coordinate security gap assessments during engineering, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness phases.
• Monitor RSO project progress, deliverables, schedules, and quality of work.
• Review technical reports, drawings, and recommendations submitted by the RSO.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary meetings involving Marine Operations, Security, HSE, Engineering, Operations, and Project teams during PFSA/PFSP development.
• Ensure all security measures recommended by the RSO are technically feasible and incorporated into facility design and operational procedures.
• Coordinate implementation of corrective actions arising from PFSA recommendations.
• Support budget preparation for ISPS implementation, including security infrastructure, systems, equipment, training, and manpower.
• Coordinate pre-verification activities prior to regulatory inspections.
• Facilitate verification by the Directorate General of Sea Transportation and other competent authorities for Statement of Compliance of a Port Facility (SoCPF).
• Coordinate closure of findings raised during verification and certification processes.
• Maintain communication with the RSO throughout the project lifecycle and ensure timely completion of all contractual deliverables.

Qualification :

• Minimum Bachelor Degree in one of the following disciplines: Marine Transportation, Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies, and all Engineering disciplines.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in Port Operation (TUKS or Tersus)
• Mandatory Certified Port Facility Security Officer (PFSO) IMO Model Course 3.21
• Have expert knowledge about vessel operations, as well as the associated Port operations.
• Good English communication skills, spoken and written.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office

This position will be placed at Site Office Cilegon
